name: 84121 · Salt Lake Cty, UT
findings: ZIP 84121 (Salt Lake Cty) has 180 nonprofit organizations. 69 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (13% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84121 (Salt Lake Cty) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84121 (Salt Lake Cty) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
